interpretation: 30-update feed-forward MAPPO did not learn safe raw control: raw collision 100% and safe capture 0% over 100 validation episodes.
Common empirical CBF reduced collision and defender boundary violations to 0% in the 5-episode diagnostic, but safe capture was 20% and timeout 80%.
The CBF result is diagnostic only, not a final comparison; no formal robust-CBF guarantee is claimed.
All target-invalid, target-boundary, and target-obstacle rates were 0%, so the failure is attributed to defender policy/safety behavior.
